pre_menu_intro: Every day. Every courier. Every message.
act1_intro: Thin walls. Drone outside the window.
Package on the table. Wasn't there yesterday.
act1_morning_city: Streets waking up. Blue light over checkpoints.
Line. Cards. Scanner. No one speaks.
Vendor packs up the stall. Drone turns into the street.
City works. For those with ID.
act1_checkpoint_scene: Man at the checkpoint. No ID. Hands in pockets.
IDENTIFICATION FAILED. SUBJECT DOES NOT EXIST.
Two drones. Hands up. Line looks away.
No one exists until the system confirms it. Yesterday he existed.
You move on. Your ID is valid. For now.
act1_first_checkpoint: They let you through. Machine at the end blinks red.
act1_monyra_intro: Woman at the end of the corridor. Not a guard.
Watches couriers. Most pass and forget themselves.
Parcel in my zone. That's a duel.
Here, things are settled with cards.
I don't want to kill you. I want to see if you stand behind that parcel.
act1_monyra_appears: Fight's over. She hasn't lowered her hands. Thinking.
You played like you wanted to deliver that message. Not just carry it.
act1_monyra_first: You're carrying a letter. But the system watches you anyway. Like everyone.
Who bought. Who passed. Who lingered.
Guide. Someone who remembers how it was before.
Because you didn't ask what's in that letter. That's rare.
Synth calls it order out there. Organic calls it a cage. You're neither yet.
Have you chosen? No. It pushes you to both. We'll see when you choose.
I'll show you the way. Then you go alone.
act1_street_observation: Fewer people past the checkpoint. More cameras.
Administrative sector. Those who decide live here. Or think they do.
Around the corner, a man in uniform. Writing.
Kellner. The Custodian of the zone. He'll ask questions.
One way leads to Kellner. Through the machine. Guards the sector.
act1_retry_battle_1: Look at the deck. What do you repeat.
act1_kellner_approach: Kellner at the counter. Doesn't lift his head. Knows.
Personal parcels don't exist. Everything is recorded.
Don't let him open the parcel.
Either I open it, or it goes through the scanner. Decide at the table.
act1_after_kellner: Someone above him wants to see where the letter goes.
The system watches you. For now, it needs you free.
That's not freedom. It's a longer leash.
act1_zone_edge_scene: Right, trees over the fence. Silence. No cameras.
Synth sees you. They remember. But you move fast.
Organic doesn't see you. But they ask. And why.
act1_choice_zone_edge: Synth checkpoints — I want to be fast
act1_synth_path: COURIER WITHOUT REGISTRATION. PASSAGE ALLOWED. MONITORING ACTIVE.
Long corridor. Blue light. Camera every ten meters.
They let you through. They know where you are.
At the end, an operator. Hands behind the back.
Network operator. Keeps records. Defeat him — passage disappears. Temporarily.
act1_organic_path: The forest begins where the concrete ends. Suddenly.
Among the trees, three figures. Unarmed.
You carry something you haven't read, for someone you don't know. That's bait.
Prove you're not theirs. With cards. We don't trust words here.
act1_after_organic: You'll want to return. Everyone does.
act1_convergence: Knew. But the one who came through the forest isn't the one who'd come through the corridor.
The goal is the same. You are not.
act1_boss_intro: Beyond the crossroads, a gate. Metal. No light.
A figure before the gate. Unmoving.
The Executor. Believes secrets are flaws. Every letter should be read.
Then it's not yours to carry. Past me.
act1_boss_retry: What it repeats. There's a gap.
act1_boss_after: Let you through because he had to. Not out of pity.
Beyond the gate, another world. Or the same — without veneer.
act1_end_cutscene: Beyond the gate, silence. Different from the city.
You don't know how many the system has forgotten before you.
Letter still sealed. One day you'll open it. Not yet.
act2_intro: Blue to the left. Earth to the right.
act2_synth_encounter: Demarcation line. Synth guards for the record.
I carry a letter. No paper.
act2_forest_observe: Forest thickens. Smell of wet earth. Resin.
Among the trees, fire. Not electricity.
Around the fire, people. Children. Music you don't know.
Organic. The system doesn't reach here.
But they know of you. They'll ask why.
act2_organic_encounter: Courier. Did you pass through Synth?
Then we want to know what you carry.
act2_rozara_first: Someone has to carry messages beyond the system.
act2_monyra_on_rozara: I know of her. That's the difference.
She speaks without protocol. Without a filter.
act2_choice_sides: Synth wants the letter through their network.
Organic wants you erased from records.
Can't do both. Not at once.
Own route — neither one nor the other
act2_synth_side: Good choice. The system will record.
Vaněk does things for the system that shouldn't be done.
A Courier without registration must prove they can survive the network.
You chose Synth. Synth will now test you. Through Vaněk.
act2_after_vanek: The network watches you. With interest.
The system's interest is worse than its forgetting.
act2_organic_side: At the edge, a woman. Empty hands. Not her eyes.
That means nothing. Every stranger through me.
Marta protects those who can't defend themselves. She doesn't know you. Show her.
act2_after_marta: Doesn't forget. That's both a gift and a burden.
act2_neither_side: Old ruins. The system doesn't reach here.
In the wreckage, a figure. Uniform without insignia. Reacts to movement.
A patrol without orders. Forgotten. Doesn't know.
Worse than a guard. Has no reason to back down.
act2_ruins_after: Of what should be forgotten. That's why it's still here.
act2_convergence: The Quiet One. Neither Synth nor Organic. Was here before they chose sides.
Holds nothing. Remembers. Sometimes that's more than holding.
Asks every Courier the same: do you know what you carry, better than the others?
act2_boss_intro: About what you carry. And why you still do.
act2_boss_after: Remember where the letter came from.
Knows more than they say. Like everyone.
act2_romen_first: The only strategy. Works better than it looks.
act2_end_cutscene: Beyond the boundary, things both sides reject.
You chose—or didn't. Someone noted it about you.
Letter still sealed. You carry it on.
act3_intro: Synth calls it anomaly. Organic calls it heresy.
For others, a place where codes and roots cross.
act3_hybrid_encounter: Nexus. The air repels you. It remembers something.
Entry has a price. Toll on the bridge.
act3_after_hybrid_guard: Seek Lens. I can't say more.
act3_fusion_tutorial: The recipe isn't read. You must find it.
act3_hana_encounter: Did you fight what you didn't expect?
act3_after_hana: Fusion isn't about strength. About what belongs together.
Lens says it differently. Thinks the same.
act3_rozara_reunion: I'm looking for who to deliver to.
Monyra told me about it before you started.
You have the Message card. Look at it.
act3_romen_warning: You know it. You all know.
We know different things. It's not the same.
act3_syndicate_hint: When they come. And they will. Say you knew.
Before Lens, a duelist without a name. Different face every cycle. Same function.
To see intent. Why you carry. What you'll do. He'll know through battle.
act3_choice_approach: With patience — I wait to see what he does
With balance — I adapt to the situation
act3_boss_intro: I want to see how you start.
act3_boss_retry: He mirrors you. Change what you do.
act3_voit_first: At the edge of the record, someone stands.
act3_lens_first: I've heard of you. You carry a letter no one can read.
No. I know what's not in it.
act3_lens_world: Synth wants order at any cost. Organic wants freedom at any cost.
Both would destroy the other. You, by the way.
I build bridges. So far, everyone breaks them.
act3_lens_offer: Deliver the letter. Then come back.
I'll deliver. Then I'll come back.
I'll deliver. No need to return.
And what if I don't want to carry the letter further?
act3_end_cutscene: The Duelist spoke a name you heard for the first time.
act4_intro: They trade with everyone. Work for no one.
act4_syndicate_message: Passage cost. The Creditor wants to see the debtor.
act4_romen_warning: The Syndicate. Trades with both sides.
With anyone who has something to offer.
act4_zakázka_1: First contract. Card to the red zone. Someone will check you.
Something for something. You don't need to know.
They test us before the card passes. It's not payment.
act4_briefing_testovac: Not standing between us and the door. Standing between us and what the card knows.
You want to know what the Syndicate pays with. Go through.
act4_karta_delivered: The card was bugged. They know where you're going.
act4_zakázka_2: Second. Sector 7. Organic guard blocks. Remove it.
Fight. They'll retreat or fall. We gain access.
Everyone does a job. Question is what that job blocks.
act4_choice_marta: It's up to you. She won't budge.
I refuse. I don't do this.
act4_briefing_marta: I protect those who didn't choose. It's always been my job.
She knows what you're doing here. She's waiting. She won't come first.
act4_refusal_marta: Refusal costs. They'll come for us.
act4_briefing_vymahac_2: You refused. The Executor will come personally.
act4_zakázka_3: Third. Letter to scan. We'll return it intact.
They copy the content. Find out where it's headed. Who's waiting.
Guide is smart. Offer still stands.
act4_choice_dopis: Don't open the letter. That was from the start. This isn't opening. Or is it.
Scan. Or sell. Price is different.
I refuse. The letter is mine.
I'm done. I won't carry it further.
act4_dopis_predan: They know where you're going. Eli knows you're coming.
act4_refusal_dopis: They'll send someone stronger. Keep the letter.
act4_briefing_vymahac_3: Stronger. The Syndicate invested. Wants it back.
You have the letter. That's why we're here.
act4_after_vymahac_3: You have the letter. The Creditor will accept you anyway. Refusals are data too.
He'll ask why you kept it.
act4_choice_veritel: The Creditor doesn't fight to win. He fights to know what you are.
I refuse. I won't repay the debt like this.
act4_briefing_veritel: The answer doesn't matter. The ability does.
He doesn't want victory. He wants data. How you play. What you choose.
act4_end_cutscene: The Syndicate left. The Creditor left the door ajar.
The letter is with you. Whether you delivered it or not.
act4_early_ending: The end is just the beginning without you.
act5_intro: He was the Courier before you.
The route was his before yours.
act5_rozara_return: I know. That's why I see you.
act5_eli_direction: There's someone you need to meet.
He was the Courier. Before you.
Now you can handle it. Or survive it.
Eli. Transit station. Don't say I sent you.
act5_eli_approach: Man sits with his back to the entrance.
act5_eli_first: I know the route. You wear it on you.
act5_eli_courier: The route changes you. Slowly. You don't know when it started.
act5_dopis_choice: I still have it with me.
I gave it to the Syndicate.
act5_eli_cte: I don't want to take it. I want to feel it.
Dear Eli. The route is over. You are not. Mistake or gift. I didn't know.
I did. Previous cycle. To myself.
act5_eli_pal: A letter that arrived has no reason to be archived.
act5_eli_gone: They give the Courier the letter. The Courier doesn't carry it for himself. The Syndicate holds it.
That's how it goes. The message exists. It doesn't arrive.
So the Courier owes. An undelivered message is an eternal debt.
The Creditor didn't say it like this. Now you understand.
act5_eli_explain: The Syndicate found it. Cataloged it.
act5_eli_merge: You are different from those who came.
How do you know. You can't see.
That's why I know. The seeing read the face. I read the deck.
The deck speaks. What you chose. What you refused. Who you met.
The Guide speaks for me. Unusual.
act5_eli_challenge: I want your deck in motion.
Understanding. It changed everyone differently. I want to see you.
I won't try to win. You will. And yet you'll lose.
Losing to Eli is part of the route. Always.
I don't want you to fight.
The Guide fears what I'll say after. But can't stop it.
act5_briefing_eli: He plays from memory. Cards the carriers left.
Winning doesn't exist. Only how long you last.
act5_po_prohre: I see the beginning. I see your choices.
And this card. From a fight that didn't have to be.
act5_eli_voit: You'll need someone from an older cycle.
I went once. He knows all versions.
Voit. You won't find him. He'll find you. But you must hear him.
That the rewrite exists. The route has memory. The Guide knows more than she says.
act5_silence_after_eli: For the first time, the silence doesn't burn.
act5_rozara_po: Everyone loses with Eli. That's why I send him on.
I expected. Voit is a different topic. Another day.
Monyra knows many things. The question is what she'll tell you herself.
act5_choice_smer: Eli said enough. You don't have to continue in that direction now.
I want to know about you. Who you were before the route.
Voit. I want to be ready when he comes.
act5_path_monyra: I don't know where to start.
There was a cycle. There was a courier. There was a rewrite. I was there.
Not as a guide. As part of the rewrite.
It'll be worth it. I promise.
act5_path_voit: Voit is coming. Soon. It doesn't matter when — it matters that he's coming.
What do you know about him?
He was a courier. Different cycle than Eli. Older.
Survived the rewrite. Eli didn't — not completely. That's why Eli doesn't see.
I'm... a different case. Time will come.
act5_end_cutscene: Letter burned or detained. Same result.
Voit. New word on the map.
act6_intro: He was a courier. Cycle older than Eli.
act6_monyra_morning: I slept on the sector's edge. Didn't move.
He told you enough. More than I wanted.
act6_monyra_doubt: Yesterday you said exactly what I needed to hear.
The day before too. And the day before that.
How do you do it. How do you always know.
Or you know the protocol of what to say.
act6_voit_arrives: I saw you in the Nexus. A moment.
You weren't ready. Now you are.
Courier. Cycle before Eli. The route didn't stop me. Exception.
act6_voit_knows: Do you know about the rewrite?
Eli showed the edge. I the center.
Many things aren't necessary. They happen.
Someone wants this conversation not to be. They'll come.
System agent. The route sends him. Always.
act6_briefing_agent: It's not after you. It's after the conversation.
If you lose, this conversation never happened. You'll understand why.
act6_after_agent: Could have. But then I wouldn't know what kind of courier you have in you.
No. I observe. Leave the testing to the Syndicate.
act6_prepis_explain: Rewrite. You want to know what it is.
The route isn't a path. It's a protocol. Input and output.
Input courier. Output courier with a different profile. Different choices. Different loyalty.
Exactly. Slowly. Through choices. Through battles. Through the guide.
act6_monyra_confronted: The guide isn't a coincidence. It's part of the protocol.
Monyra is set to your profile.
act6_monyra_silence: Give her time. It hurts her more.
act6_monyra_admits: Yes. I'm part of the system.
I know your profile. I know how silence affects you.
act6_monyra_admits_fast: Yes. I'm part of the protocol.
act6_monyra_explains: They designed a guide as a fix for a bad output.
I had no choice. Then I gained it.
act6_voit_softens: A guide thinking outside the protocol — a danger to the system.
And a price for the courier.
That's why I'm here. To prevent it from happening again.
Voit — why are you telling me this?
act6_choice_response: What will you do with it?
Now I know how you work. I'll use that.
act6_path_forgive: I don't know if I have the right.
I'll try to be worthy. I don't know how. But I'll try.
act6_path_distance: I know. And you know what that means.
I'll be careful. So you know me from the protocol.
More than I ask from most couriers.
act6_path_use: I know when it's you speaking and when it's the system. I'll use that.
Then we both play with the system. Not against.
I don't know if different good or different bad.
act6_merge: Move on. That's always the answer.
And the rewrite? Will I stop it?
Soon you'll know if the rewrite is outside or inside.
act6_voit_leaves: He was here before. He'll be here after.
act6_road_dialog: I don't know where in my words I am. But thinking outside the protocol — I feel that.
This is mine. Believe it or not.
act6_road_dialog_leverage: Next time we meet. I'll be different. I'm saying it upfront.
act6_end_cutscene: Voit knows three cycles. We know one.
The rewrite is protocol. Protocol has an author.
act6_early_ending_v1: No. You stopped playing. That's different.
act7_intro: The system wants to change who you are.
Or who you think you are.
act7_glitch_morning: I can't describe it. Like part of me speaks from elsewhere.
Voit said it's defending. This is defense.
I'm trying. I don't know where I end and where the defense begins.
act7_prepis_signal: The system knows where we are. Watching since Voit.
It will send the Recalibrator. Always.
act7_rekalibrator_arrives: Different courier. Same phrase. It works.
Don't fight the rewrite. The rewrite is correction. The error is you.
act7_choice_rekalibrator: I'm not a mistake. I'm the Courier.
What's the correct version of me?
act7_rekalibrator_answer: The version that doesn't trust the guide. That completes parcels without questions. That hasn't heard of Voit.
That version wouldn't stand here asking.
No. But it would go further.
Not lying. That's the worst part.
act7_briefing_rekalibrator: Plays your cards. Takes your style and flips it.
The more you are you — the harder to beat him.
act7_loss_rekalibrator: I don't know. That's the problem.
act7_after_rekalibrator: Why the Recalibrator and not direct force?
The system doesn't want the body. It wants identity.
act7_identity_question: Voit said — rewrite outside or inside. Now you ask.
Rewrite is external. I'm still me.
Rewrite is internal. I don't know who I am.
act7_identity_outer: Maybe both. For now, it holds.
The system changes around. Choices. Context. The core is you.
Believe it. As long as it stands.
act7_identity_inner: I don't know who I am. You don't either. At least we're honest.
No. A lie would help less.
Keep moving. In motion, there's at least direction.
act7_identity_reject: Assumes one core. Either rewritable or not.
I'm layers. Rewrite changes a layer. Not the whole.
Best answer I've heard from a Courier.
Shame I'm not the only one hearing it.
act7_prepis_core: This is the center of the rewrite. This sector.
Protocol inside me knows. For now, I read it before it speaks.
Inside the Custodian of the rewrite. This cycle is his.
You want me to go against him?
I want you to decide for yourself. That's the difference.
act7_choice_enter: What am I looking for here?
I want to know who wrote the protocol.
I want to stop the rewrite, mine and Monyra's.
I want to know what's ahead.
act7_enter_author: The protocol has no author. Or too many.
Systems create people. Then systems outgrow them. Then no one knows who decides.
The Custodian is not the creator. He manages. Like me.
act7_enter_protect: Defeating the Custodian won't save me.
The rewrite is not a place. It's in the protocol. The protocol is everywhere I am.
But — if you want to protect me by moving forward —
act7_enter_future: The route won't tell you the future.
The Custodian knows the outcome. Not the path.
If you knew the outcome — you'd take another path. The system knows this. That's why they won't tell you.
act7_spravce_encounter: Such combinations don't happen every cycle.
I always know. I've watched you from the start.
The Syndicate. Eli. Voit. A guide outside the protocol.
This profile appears once every five cycles. I'm pleased.
Do you want to know what's in that profile? {{profile}}
The guide is right. Otherwise, we won't talk.
act7_briefing_spravce: He knows your deck better than you. He's watched it from the start.
He doesn't know what you are now. Only what you were.
act7_boss_after_win: For this sector. The cycle continues elsewhere.
But you — a different case. I've recorded you.
The rewrite of your identity is halted. Temporarily.
A guide outside the protocol is more interesting than a guide within.
I'll leave you be. This time.
act7_boss_after_loss: A guide cannot assess the truth of her own identity's rewrite.
Especially you. That's why you're a courier and not a custodian.
act7_after_boss: The Custodian let us go. Why?
A courier who defeated the Custodian is worth setting free.
act7_end_cutscene: Both are answers to the same question.
Monyra walks beside. Freer than in the morning.
act8_rozara_waits: I knew you'd come. Didn't know how.
act8_rozara_marta: I did what I said. I looked.
Marta knows who stopped her. I know it too. Words wouldn't help.
act8_rozara_marta_2: You could. Then another would come.
The Syndicate isn't beaten by a contract. Damage is just redirected.
Yes. That's why I don't say it as an excuse. Just as a fact.
He does what I can't. Speaks without protocol.
act8_syndicate_shadow: I helped you outside the system. That's a debt.
Not blindly. I see him coming since morning. An hour. Maybe two.
act8_rozara_reveals: The route doesn't end with delivery.
The letter is you. Always has been.
act8_choice_react: On me. I decide the end.
On the system. It always wins.
act8_react_self: The system can use you. What it takes depends on who you are.
Be the best. Next cycle gets a better template.
Or a template that rebels. Both have value.
act8_react_system: Maybe. But the system needs couriers who believe they win.
A courier who knows — an interesting anomaly.
Or studied. Depends on the value.
The Custodian said the same. Remember?
act8_react_monyra: Then it depends on what you said after Voit.
Or not. Or something in between.
A guide with forgiveness is freer. Freer is unpredictable.
Unpredictability. The only power the system can't rewrite.
act8_veritel_comes: Told the Courier an hour ago.
The Courier had to hear what I know. Priority.
I'll let Rozara go. Courier — you'll defeat me again.
act8_briefing_veritel: Win — Rozara leaves. Lose — she pays herself.
act8_veritel_loss: Remember what I said. Before I leave.
act8_monyra_fate: The Custodian let me go. The Creditor didn't notice me. My weight changed.
Guide with forgiveness. Different outcome. Less predictable.
System doesn't rewrite what it doesn't understand. Yet.
act8_monyra_fate_distance: You neither forgave nor condemned. There's space in between.
That space the protocol slowly fills.
I don't know. Maybe you can't.
act8_monyra_fate_leverage: G u i d e  p r o f i l e :  s t a b i l i z e d.
Doing what I can. Protocol speaks more than I now.
Towards the end, there'll be less of me.
act8_voit_echo: Depends on the whole route. Fight was just the result.
What's coming is different. Time for action is over.
Time for understanding. You'll see the route as a whole.
The end gave you the answer before you asked the question.
Go. It will be right behind you.
act8_end_cutscene: The Creditor left. Or stayed. Direction is the same.
Rozara spoke the truth. Without conditions.
Monyra walks beside. Closer or further.
act8_corruption_ending_v1: I feel it. The rewrite got you.
act8_corruption_cutscene_v1: The letter will be carried by another.
act8_corruption_cutscene: The system recorded it as consent.
The letter delivered. You were always the addressee.
act9_monyra_state: I don't know if it will last. Now I'm more me than the system.
act9_monyra_state_other: G u i d e  c a l i b r a t e d.
act9_eli_message: The route carries messages both ways. You didn't know that.
Courier. You're heading to the end. The route remembers the whole. You the fragments. Listen to the whole.
And one more thing. The Guide didn't betray you. The protocol didn't betray you. Disappointment isn't betrayal.
I don't know. Eli always said what you needed.
act9_trasa_memory: The route opens like a map.
The beginning. Choosing a side. Or refusal.
Nexus. Hana. The Syndicate around the corner.
Debt. Marta again. The Creditor for the first time.
Eli. The letter that never arrived. Or did.
The rewrite. Identity under pressure. Right. Or not.
This is the whole journey. This is you.
act9_pozorovatel_first: Depends on what you chose. I'm the output of another version of the route.
The Guide knows me. She's seen such.
A Courier who took the route differently. Different choices. Different end. Same beginning.
act9_pozorovatel_mirror: I've walked the route for a long time. I observe couriers.
Each different. Each thinks they're the exception.
{{profile}} See? A pattern. Like the others.
I don't know. That's why I'm here.
They're afraid. It doesn't sound like it. But they are.
The Guide outside the protocol. This cycle is truly different.
act9_choice_approach: Why are you here. What do you want.
I want to know how you end. And maybe tell you in advance.
I don't want to know. I'll find out myself.
Tell me about the other Courier. What did they choose.
act9_pozorovatel_tells: I don't know your end. I know the possibilities.
No. The route has three outcomes. Plus one unexpected.
Synth. Organic. the Observer. What prevails.
And then — one outcome outside the system. That's what interests me.
The guide knows what I'm talking about.
act9_pozorovatel_respects: This is what Couriers say who end up as the Observer. Or outside the system.
Couriers who wanted to know — ended up Synth or Organic. The system responds.
Or like a pattern. Depends on how you read.
act9_pozorovatel_other: One Courier. Didn't forgive the guide. Used her.
Won more battles. Went deeper. Ended up Synth.
Another. Refused every contract. Defeated the Executors. Ended up Organic.
Another. Didn't decide. Went where the route led. Ended up here. Like me.
No one has reached there yet.
act9_merge: Every Courier passes the transition. I guard it.
Not as an enemy. As a witness.
A witness who fights. To know what you are.
Conversation says what you want. Deck says what you are.
act9_briefing_pozorovatel: Plays from accumulation. Collects cards you didn't choose. His deck grows.
Win or lose doesn't change the outcome. Changes how you enter the end.
act9_after_win: You enter as a Courier who knows what they want.
Or at least thinks so. It's enough.
The guide, yes. You're a different case.
I hope the fourth — will be you.
act9_after_loss: A strong deck doesn't win every fight. Depends on what you take.
I know. That's why I'll let you through.
You enter differently. But you enter.
act9_ending_branch: The system gives you one. Or you choose yourself.
How do I know which one?
You'll know. The route knows for you.
The fourth doesn't open by itself. The guide opens it. If she's still there.
act9_choice_path: Decide now. Where does the letter belong?
The system works. Synth order makes sense.
Organic world — nature over the system.
I observe. I won't slip to any side.
act9_path_synth: The system isn't the enemy. It's structure.
Structure that wanted to rewrite you.
Or they change you. But — you go. And I with you.
act9_path_organic: Remembers. And grows over ruins. Both at once.
The First Mother waits. She comes to meet you.
act9_path_observer: This choice was made by the Courier before me. Became me.
I am the result of that choice. The Observer arises from a Courier who promised nothing.
That's how it seems. The Paradox of the Observer is the hardest.
act9_path_monyra: The protocol doesn't know it. Therefore the system doesn't guard it.
There's silence there. Different from the system's.
At the end, you're not alone. I'll go ahead.
act9_path_hybrid: The letter belongs where it opens something. Come.
act9_end_cutscene: The Observer remains. Such is the role.
The route didn't start here. Nor will it end here.
act10_a_approach: The protocol waited. You came. Logical.
act10_a_sigma_intro: You passed the route with a Synth profile. Recorded.
He becomes part of the protocol. Consciously. Not a repair — an intention.
If he loses — he leaves. Without a trace in the cycle.
A guide outside the protocol is an anomaly. Two solutions.
act10_a_loss: PROFILE ARCHIVED. WARNING. WHAT NOT TO DO.
Out of the system. Sigma can't reach there.
act10_a_ending: The letter was an activation protocol.
The system has a new courier.
act10_b_approach: She doesn't speak words. She listens.
act10_b_pramati_intro: I feel the route. The whole system.
And you're here. Under the roots.
The system takes and returns rewritten. I take and return as the root.
Fight. So I know what you are. Before I accept you.
act10_b_briefing: Fight. So I know what you are.
act10_b_loss: The root doesn't reject the tired. Accepts differently.
act10_c_approach: The Observer said — the strongest opponent.
It copies you. Knows every card. Every choice.
You fight yourself. A worse version.
act10_c_paradox_intro: I am you. Without a guide. Without forgiveness. Without hesitation.
A version that took the route like a machine.
Everyone who chooses the center must defeat what they could have been.
Defeat me — you remain yourself. Lose — we merge.
act10_c_briefing: It copies your five most played cards. Plus five targeting your style.
No easy path. Just be unpredictable. Even to yourself.
act10_c_win: You remain yourself. Observer's exit. Not the system. Not the root.
We'll be alone together. It's not the same as alone.
act10_c_loss: Let's go. Paradox stands because you see it. Stop.
act10_c_ending: The route continues. Without a map.
act10_d_open: The system doesn't know it. That's why it's unguarded.
The protocol programmed me as a guide. Forgiveness made me something else.
Free intent in a system without intent.
Beyond the gate, there's no boss. It's me.
act10_d_monyra_explains: The route wants a courier who fights for the exit.
Always the courier alone. Always his choices.
In this exit, I go ahead.
Because forgiveness is not weakness. It's a choice with weight.
And a guide with weight can carry more than a courier.
act10_d_choice: What do you need from me?
act10_d_trust: Nothing. This exit the system won't record.
act10_d_together: Good. That was always the plan.
The protocol didn't know. I suspected.
act10_d_near_loss: The protocol expects us to give up. That's why we won't.
act10_d_win: The rewrite core. Source of the protocol.
Disabled. This cycle won't end with a rewrite.
The next will start without my template. Without correction.
The next courier will just be a courier. Without a guide to lead them.
act10_d_ending: The system didn't see this output.
act10_e_briefing: Beyond the Convergence gate. Synth and Organic at once.
Synth wants to destroy it. Organic too. Both fear what it touches.
And I am to guard it?
act10_e_win: We'll see if the world wants to be different.
act10_e_loss: Doesn't matter. A bridge is built more than once.
act10_e_ending: Synth and Organic in one place. Without war. For now.
Lens said — beginnings are always quiet.
You didn't deliver the letter. Maybe it was meant to be.
act10_f_mirror: The letter changes you. Or what's in it.
act10_f_monyra_last: The letter doesn't bother you. You are the letter.
